newsitem.title: USA: AT&T cuts Md. rates by over $18 mln annually.
newsitem.headline: AT&T cuts Md. rates by over $18 mln annually.

text.p: BALTIMORE, Md., Dec 17 -- AT&T Corp said on Tuesday it would reduce rates for its customers in Maryland by more than $18 million a year, effective January 1.
AT&T's new prices were a result of lower access charges paid to Bell Atlantic-Maryland to connect long distance calls to its local network.
The company said it planned to lower long distance prices in Maryland by 17 percent on average for residential customers, and rates could drop by as much as 30 percent on some calls.
AT&T said customers in Maryland who used AT&T for local toll calls could now save 24 percent on average by dialing 10288 or 1OATT before the area code and telephone number.
